oopbuy-spreadsheet-template.title: OOPBuy Spreadsheet Template: Free PDF & CSV Planner
oopbuy-spreadsheet-template.description: Download a free OOPBuy PDF or CSV planner to record product links, variants, QC decisions and parcel quotes without mixing estimates with payments.

sections.heading: Choose a planner rather than another unverified product list
paragraphs: This free OOPBuy spreadsheet template is a planning record for your own shortlist. The PDF is designed for printing and handwritten notes; the CSV provides plain text fields that you can import into a spreadsheet application. Neither download contains a verified product catalogue, places an order or connects to your OOPBuy account. Use the product directory to discover candidates, then use this planner to record what you actually checked before committing money.

Choose PDF when you want a compact checklist beside your browser or a parcel record you can annotate. Choose CSV when you want to sort rows, add your own columns and keep several candidates together. The CSV has no formulas, automatic exchange rates or live price updates. A blank field means you still need information, not that its cost is zero. Keep that distinction visible when comparing a promising item with a complete, ready-to-buy option.

sections.heading: Give every product and variant a separate record
paragraphs: Start with a short item name that you will recognise later, the original product URL and the exact variant. A label such as black sweatshirt, medium, seller size chart checked is more useful than a copied advertising headline. Record the marketplace item identifier when it is available. Keep the original marketplace link beside any agent link so you can distinguish a product identity problem from a link-loading problem without guessing a replacement URL.

Use a separate record when the size, colour, material option or bundle changes the price or your decision. Two options on one listing are not necessarily interchangeable. If you are comparing alternatives, keep their references distinct until you select one. Do not overwrite a rejected candidate with a new seller's listing: mark the first candidate rejected and explain why. This preserves the evidence behind the decision and avoids ordering the wrong item from a previously opened tab.

sections.heading: Record prices with their currency and observation date
paragraphs: Enter the source price and currency together, followed by the date you checked the selected option. Keep domestic freight separate because seller-to-warehouse delivery is different from international parcel transport. A displayed starting price may belong to another size or quantity, so check the chosen variant before recording it. When a figure is only a directory reference, label it as a reference instead of replacing it with a supposedly current amount that you have not verified.

Do not total CNY and EUR values in one column. You can add your own converted estimate in your spreadsheet application, but keep the original currency, rate and date alongside it. Mark payment or conversion charges as unknown until they are shown for your method. For example, a source price of 100 CNY is a hypothetical recording exercise, not a current product recommendation or a promise about the amount charged to a European payment card.

sections.heading: Turn QC observations into a clear next action
paragraphs: When the item reaches the warehouse, compare its identity and selected option with your record before assessing appearance. Write down the relevant QC observation and the decision: review needed, hold, request clarification, return request or approved for parcel planning. These are your planning labels, not guaranteed OOPBuy interface statuses. A photo showing a size label answers a different question from a measurement photo; record which question has actually been answered and which still needs evidence.

Attach or privately store your order references and detailed photographs in a place you control. The public template does not need your password, address or payment information. If you ask support for a correction, note the date, the issue and the next expected response. Revisit the record promptly while the item is still in the warehouse. Do not interpret an unresolved QC concern as approval merely because other items in the same shopping list are ready.

sections.heading: Keep product weight separate from packed parcel measurements
paragraphs: Enter a product weight only when you have a defensible source, and state whether it came from the seller or warehouse. An image, price or popularity counter cannot establish weight. Leave unknown values blank and identify the action needed to obtain them. Product weight is useful for an early plan, but the eventual parcel also includes its packaging. Treat a warehouse item measurement and a final packed parcel measurement as different observations rather than quietly replacing one with the other.

Record the final parcel's length, width and height in centimetres and weight in grams, matching the fields requested by OOPBuy's shipping estimator. Keep the units next to the numbers when you copy them into another tool. In a hypothetical example, a 2,000 g parcel at 40 by 30 by 20 cm occupies 24,000 cubic centimetres. That volume is not a chargeable weight or shipping price until the selected route's current billing rule is known.

sections.heading: Build a separate quote record for each parcel scenario
paragraphs: For every shipping scenario, record destination, product type, packed measurements, route name and quote date. Add the displayed quote and currency, plus what the quote says it includes. Note packaging services, insurance or coupons separately when they are shown. If a route has a limit or an unanswered condition, record it in the action field. This makes two scenarios comparable instead of leaving you with screenshots that use different assumptions and cannot be reconciled later.

An item row and a parcel quote are different units of information. Avoid adding the full international quote to every item and then summing those repeated amounts. Use one parcel reference to connect the relevant items to one quote record. If you later split the parcel, create two new scenario records and compare their combined displayed costs with the original scenario. Do not assume either consolidation or splitting must win before checking the available routes and packaging requirements.

sections.heading: Import the CSV without losing links or identifiers
paragraphs: Use your spreadsheet application's import function and select UTF-8 text with comma-separated fields. If everything appears in one column, check the delimiter instead of manually cutting up links. Treat item identifiers, URLs and descriptive fields as text; spreadsheet applications sometimes reinterpret long numbers or values that resemble dates. Keep an unchanged copy of the downloaded template so you can start another comparison without carrying old decisions into a new purchase.

The download deliberately contains no calculations or macros. Any totals, currency conversions or reminders you add are your own working rules and should be checked before you rely on them. If you paste seller text beginning with formula characters, import it as text rather than allowing the spreadsheet to run it as an instruction. Sharing a filled planner is optional: remove order references and private notes first, and share only the product information the recipient actually needs.

sections.heading: Review the same record at three useful checkpoints
paragraphs: Before ordering, confirm the original link, exact option, observed price, domestic freight and unresolved questions. After warehouse arrival, add QC observations and the available item measurements, then make an explicit hold or approval decision. Before international payment, create a current parcel quote using final packing data and verify the selected route's terms. These checkpoints correspond to different evidence becoming available; a completed first stage does not mean later figures are already settled.

Keep earlier dated observations when an important value changes. A short note explaining that dimensions were updated after packing can explain a revised quote without assuming an error. If a return, cancellation or refund follows, record the requested action and confirmed outcome separately. A request is not the same as a completed refund. The goal is a traceable sequence that helps you ask a specific question, not a decorative sheet in which every field looks complete.

sections.heading: Know what a free OOPBuy template cannot decide
paragraphs: A planning template cannot authenticate a product, guarantee a seller, reserve stock or predict a carrier's final bill. It also cannot verify a coupon, decide import requirements or determine whether a particular item is eligible for a route. Use the official account and current route information for those decisions. Our PDF and CSV organise your observations; the product links, prices and dates you enter remain your responsibility to check against the source before purchase.

Download the version in your language, complete one candidate record and run one realistic parcel scenario before expanding the shortlist. If the first record exposes missing dimensions or an unclear variant, resolve that gap first. A small list with current evidence is easier to act on than a large list of assumed bargains. Continue with the spreadsheet guide for product discovery, the link troubleshooting guide for loading problems and the shipping guide when you are ready to compare parcel plans.

oopbuy-shipping-spain.title: OOPBuy Shipping to Spain: Costs, Size & Delivery Stages
oopbuy-shipping-spain.description: Plan OOPBuy shipping to Spain with exact destination details, parcel dimensions and comparable quotes. Separate warehouse work from delivery estimates.

sections.heading: Start with the destination and parcel, not a universal price
paragraphs: To estimate OOPBuy shipping to Spain, use the current official shipping estimator with your destination, product type, weight and dimensions. This guide does not publish a fixed euro price or a guaranteed delivery window because it has not obtained a live quote for your parcel. A useful answer depends on what you are sending, how it is packed and which route is available when you pay. Treat other buyers' totals as questions to investigate, not interchangeable quotes.

A search for OOPBuy España may cover very different needs: buying from Spain, paying for the item, estimating an international parcel or tracking a delivery already in transit. Identify your stage before choosing the next action. If the seller has not dispatched the goods, an international transit estimate does not explain the delay. If the item is already stored, the useful information is its warehouse measurements, QC decision and suitability for the routes available to your exact destination.

sections.heading: Confirm the exact Spanish destination details
paragraphs: Select the intended destination in the estimator and confirm the full delivery address in your account before submitting a parcel. Do not assume that one route description covers every Spanish postcode or territory. Mainland, island and other territory addresses may need additional checking against the current service conditions. This is a coverage check, not a statement of customs treatment. If the destination cannot be selected clearly, ask OOPBuy which destination option and route match the actual address.

Keep personal address details out of public comparisons and screenshots. You can record the destination region and a private postcode check in your planner without publishing a recipient's name or telephone number. Ask a specific question when coverage is unclear: whether the named service accepts the intended postcode, whether an additional delivery condition applies and where that condition appears in the quote. Do not change the destination to reveal a cheaper result that cannot actually deliver your parcel.

sections.heading: Separate the cost stages before comparing routes
paragraphs: Record the product purchase and seller-to-warehouse freight separately from the international parcel quote. Other amounts may appear through the selected payment method, optional warehouse services or route checkout; verify the actual items shown instead of assuming a universal percentage. A low product price does not establish a low delivered cost. The useful comparison is between complete, dated scenarios with the same selected products and destination, while clearly identifying amounts that are still unknown.

Keep the displayed currency with each amount. If one quote is in CNY and another in EUR, do not compare their number values directly. Record any conversion method and date you use for budgeting, then recheck the amount shown by the payment provider before approval. This guide does not provide a tax calculation or assume that a route label settles every possible charge. Read the current inclusion and exclusion wording and seek clarification when it does not answer your specific parcel question.

sections.heading: Enter weight and dimensions with consistent units
paragraphs: The official estimator requests weight in grams and parcel dimensions in centimetres alongside destination and product type. Use seller information only as an early estimate; use warehouse measurements when available and final packed dimensions for the last comparison. A pair of shoes without its original box and the same pair protected in a large carton are not identical shipping inputs. Unknown measurements should remain identified as unknown instead of being filled with an optimistic number to obtain a low estimate.

Consider a hypothetical 2,000 g parcel measuring 40 by 30 by 20 cm. Its volume is 24,000 cubic centimetres. If suitable repacking changes only the height to 15 cm, volume becomes 18,000 cubic centimetres, a 25% reduction. This does not promise a 25% freight saving. Whether the quote changes depends on the route's chargeable-weight method, increments and limits. Enter both scenarios under the same destination and product type before judging the financial effect.

sections.heading: Compare route details rather than the cheapest headline
paragraphs: For each available route, save its name, quoted currency and amount, measurement assumptions and observation date. Read the permitted product types, parcel limits, tracking information and stated transit estimate. Record whether the wording describes working days or another time basis. When a detail is absent, mark it unresolved and ask about that detail before payment. A route that fails a product restriction or destination condition should not remain in the comparison merely because its displayed amount looks attractive.

Check any optional protection or compensation terms for the selected service. Do not assume that every route includes identical cover or that a generic insurance label answers what evidence is needed after damage or loss. Also verify coupon eligibility and expiry in the account; a promotion someone used previously may not apply to your parcel. Save the final quote and accepted options together so you can later identify what you selected, instead of reconstructing the order from a price alone.

sections.heading: Test packing and consolidation without weakening protection
paragraphs: After approving warehouse QC, compare a sensible combined parcel with a justified alternative, such as separating one bulky item. Splitting can duplicate parcel-level charges, while combining can increase dimensions or reduce available routes. Neither choice is always cheaper. Request measured data for the packing arrangement you intend to use and compare the current displayed quotes. Include any optional packing charge in the record so a lower transport quote does not hide an additional service cost elsewhere.

Removing a box or compressing a soft item should depend on the product's protection needs and your preference for keeping its packaging. Do not remove protective material merely to reproduce another buyer's low dimensions. Fragile, structured or easily creased items may need a different plan from ordinary clothing. If a packing change is made, recalculate using the revised measurements before paying. The earlier estimate remains a useful reference, but it no longer describes the parcel that will actually be shipped.

sections.heading: Read delivery time as a sequence of separate stages
paragraphs: An OOPBuy purchase can involve agent purchasing, seller dispatch, domestic delivery, warehouse receiving, QC review, parcel preparation and international transport. The selected route's transit wording may cover only part of that sequence. Record the latest completed event and the event you are waiting for. If a seller parcel is marked delivered but the item is not stored yet, the relevant investigation is warehouse receiving; an estimate for international shipping to Spain will not resolve that missing step.

Once the international parcel is dispatched, use the route and tracking reference shown in your account. Compare the last physical scan with the carrier's tracking information when available. A newly created label and a carrier acceptance scan are different events. If progress appears stalled, send support the parcel reference, last recorded event and date, plus any action request you received. Do not pay again or create another parcel simply because tracking has not changed for a period you did not verify against the service's current guidance.

sections.heading: Keep a Spain quote comparison you can reproduce
paragraphs: Make one record per scenario with a clear name, such as original packing or suitable repacking. Keep destination, product type, actual weight, all three dimensions, route, quote currency, included services and quote date together. Add the unresolved action and the reason for selecting or rejecting each option. A comparison with blank prices is still useful when it exposes missing measurements; it becomes misleading only when those blanks are silently treated as free transport or guaranteed availability.

For a simple comparison, change one assumption at a time. First compare two packing arrangements with the same contents, then compare the available routes for the arrangement you prefer. If the contents or destination also change, make a fresh scenario instead of presenting it as a like-for-like saving. The downloadable planner supports this record, but it does not retrieve quotes or calculate current shipping charges. Enter the live values yourself and retain the final account record privately.

sections.heading: Complete the final checks before international payment
paragraphs: Confirm that every included item has an explicit QC decision and that unresolved returns or exchanges are excluded from the shipping plan. Check destination details, final packed measurements, product eligibility and the current route conditions. Read what the payable amount includes and resolve any unanswered charge or coverage question. Use accurate information for the shipment and consult the relevant official destination guidance when needed; a spreadsheet or this article cannot determine the requirements of an individual shipment.

The best next step is a current, reproducible quote for your actual parcel to Spain. If the route is unavailable, the address is unclear or the budget only works with guessed dimensions, pause the parcel decision and obtain the missing information. Continue with the general shipping guide for chargeable-weight concepts, the delivery-stage guide for a stalled order and the planner for keeping the evidence together. Recheck the quote after packing changes and before payment, even when an earlier scenario looked affordable.

oopbuy-links-not-working.title: OOPBuy Links Not Working: Taobao, Weidian & 1688 Checks
oopbuy-links-not-working.description: Troubleshoot an OOPBuy product link by checking the original listing, item ID, selected option and import result before retrying or contacting support.

sections.heading: Identify which link and which step failed
paragraphs: An OOPBuy link not working can mean several different things: the original marketplace listing will not open, a directory link leads to the wrong item, the agent cannot load the product or the required option cannot be selected. Start by recording the exact message and the stage where it appears. These problems need different checks. Repeatedly pasting the same link without identifying the failing stage rarely tells you whether the item still exists or is eligible to purchase.

Keep three references separate: the directory page where you found the item, its original Taobao, Weidian or 1688 product URL, and the product or order page shown inside OOPBuy. The directory is a discovery route, while the marketplace identifies the seller's listing and the agent handles the purchase workflow. A failure at one layer does not prove that all three are broken. Keep the source item ID visible in your notes so you can compare the destination accurately.

sections.heading: Check that the source is a product listing
paragraphs: Open the original source through the normal marketplace page when it is available. Confirm that it identifies one product rather than a shop homepage, search-results page, image gallery or general category. Copy the product's actual shared link using the marketplace's normal controls. Do not invent a conversion pattern by replacing a domain or adding a guessed item parameter. A URL that looks similar to another working example can still point to an unrelated listing or omit information needed to identify the item.

Short share links and copied app text may need to be opened through the marketplace's supported flow before you can confirm the product destination. If the page requires sign-in, use the normal account process; do not interpret that screen alone as proof that the item is unavailable. Preserve the original link while checking it. Avoid copying someone else's order page or any URL containing private account information into a public discussion or a shared product spreadsheet.

sections.heading: Compare item identity before changing anything
paragraphs: Match the marketplace item identifier, seller, product photographs and intended option against the candidate you saved. A similar product title is weak evidence because sellers can use near-identical wording across different listings. If a directory link has changed destination, return to the source evidence rather than ordering the closest visual match. Record the mismatch clearly: wrong product, wrong seller or wrong option. This makes a later support request much more useful than a general statement that the link is broken.

Do not merge two listings simply because their images look alike. Their available sizes, prices, materials or return conditions may differ. Treat a seller's replacement listing as a new candidate until you have checked those details. Keep both identifiers in your planner with their observation dates so a comparison remains traceable. If you cannot establish that the destination is the intended item, stop before purchase and ask for the missing source information instead of guessing from an attractive photograph.

sections.heading: Separate a removed listing from an unavailable option
paragraphs: A product page may open while the specific size or colour you need is unavailable. Conversely, a saved directory thumbnail may remain visible after the seller's listing has been removed. Check the complete source page and chosen variant, not only the preview image or starting price. Record whether the entire listing fails, only an option is disabled or the stock information is unclear. These observations help you decide whether to retry the link, choose a genuinely acceptable alternative or abandon the candidate.

When another option is available, compare it on its own terms. Do not select the cheapest option merely to make an order form proceed if it does not describe what you want. If the seller has moved to a new listing, obtain and verify that listing separately. A cached price, old community post or previous buyer's order does not reserve current inventory. The fact that someone once bought the item is evidence of an earlier purchase, not a guarantee that your selected variant can be ordered today.

sections.heading: Use OOPBuy's normal product-link workflow
paragraphs: Follow the current official buying workflow: submit the product link through OOPBuy, inspect the loaded product information and select the intended option before paying. After the import, compare its item identity with your source record again. Check the currency, quantity, selected specification and any domestic freight displayed. An imported product page is a useful intermediate step, but it does not by itself confirm that your exact variant is in stock or that the seller will accept the order.

If the source opens normally but OOPBuy cannot load it, record that distinction and ask whether the listing is supported through the current purchasing service. Use an alternative official ordering method only if OOPBuy provides one for your situation. Do not install an unverified extension, alter a warning or misdescribe the item to make an import succeed. The purpose of troubleshooting is to establish the correct supported purchase path, not to suppress information that could affect eligibility or the order outcome.

sections.heading: Treat purchase and shipping restrictions as real conditions
paragraphs: A product can be visible on a Chinese marketplace while being unsuitable for an agent purchase or the international route you intend to use. A restriction message is different from a loading error. Keep its wording and ask the platform what it means for the exact listing and destination. Do not change product categories, remove identifying information or use a different link solely to conceal the same restricted item. A technically loaded page does not establish that the full transaction is permitted or deliverable.

Check international transport before committing to an item that may require special handling. For example, a product containing a battery or liquid deserves a specific eligibility check rather than an assumption based on an ordinary clothing quote. This guide does not classify any individual product or promise a route for it. The official account and current route conditions govern the available services. If no suitable supported route is confirmed, keep the item out of the ready-to-buy shortlist.

sections.heading: Retry carefully when the problem appears temporary
paragraphs: If the product identity is confirmed and the problem looks like an interrupted load, retry through the normal interface after checking the message. Preserve the original link and your selected option before refreshing. Compare the official website and official app only when both are available to you, and note where the issue occurs. This can help support distinguish a source-listing problem from a particular interface problem. Do not repeatedly submit purchases merely to test whether the product now loads.

If you already clicked an order or payment action, inspect the order list and payment record before trying again. A missing confirmation screen is not proof that nothing happened. Keep the transaction question separate from the link-loading question so you do not create duplicate orders while diagnosing a display error. When the page still fails after a careful retry, send a concise report rather than cycling through guessed links. A screenshot of the exact error can be useful if private details are removed.

sections.heading: Send support a reproducible link report
paragraphs: Provide the original product URL, marketplace item ID, intended size or colour, time of the attempt and exact message. State whether the source listing opens and whether the problem appears before or after OOPBuy loads the product. Include an existing order reference only when the issue concerns that order, through the platform's appropriate private support channel. Never send passwords, verification codes or full payment-card details as troubleshooting evidence. The useful evidence identifies the item and failure, not your account credentials.

Ask one clear question: whether the source is supported, whether the option is available, whether a restriction applies or how to correct an import mismatch. A report such as source opens, item ID matches, blue medium cannot be selected is actionable. A message saying everything is broken is not. Keep the response and next step in your planner. If support supplies a different product link, verify its identity and option again before treating it as an approved replacement.

sections.heading: Maintain links and decisions after the problem is solved
paragraphs: Once the correct product loads, save the checked source link, exact option, price currency and date. Mark the earlier link as superseded or rejected instead of deleting the explanation. Continue with warehouse QC after the item arrives; successful importing does not replace inspection of the actual received product. If the option, price or seller changes before purchase, repeat the relevant checks. Link maintenance is an ongoing part of a useful shortlist, not a one-time guarantee attached to a directory badge.

Use the free planner to keep the discovery route, product identity and next action together. The spreadsheet guide explains how to compare candidates, while the support guide helps organise an unresolved case. If no reliable source or supported purchase path can be established, choose another documented candidate instead of spending more time on speculative URL edits. A working link is valuable when it leads to the correct, currently available item through a process you can verify and follow.
